metrics.visualTitle: Runs and model cost by month (USD)

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			"Run_count", '_Measures'[Run count],
			"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Date'[Year-Month number], 1, 'Date'[Year-Month], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year-Month number], 'Date'[Year-Month]

DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Agent'[Agent], "Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost])

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(5, __SQDS0Core, [Model_cost], 0)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Agent'[Agent],
			__SQDS0BodyLimited,
			"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost],
			"Agent_cost_rank", IGNORE('_Measures'[Agent cost rank])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Model_cost], 0, 'Agent'[Agent], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Model_cost] DESC, 'Agent'[Agent]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Incidents'[Category], "Incident_count", '_Measures'[Incident count])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Incident_count], 0, 'Incidents'[Category], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Incident_count] DESC, 'Incidents'[Category]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Run_count", '_Measures'[Run count],
		"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost],
		"Cost_per_run", '_Measures'[Cost per run],
		"Spend", '_Measures'[Spend],
		"Block_rate", '_Measures'[Block rate],
		"Incident_rate", '_Measures'[Incident rate],
		"Run_count_MoM__", '_Measures'[Run count MoM %],
		"Model_cost_MoM__", '_Measures'[Model cost MoM %],
		"Cost_per_run_MoM__", '_Measures'[Cost per run MoM %],
		"Spend_MoM__", '_Measures'[Spend MoM %],
		"Block_rate_MoM_pp", '_Measures'[Block rate MoM pp],
		"Incident_rate_MoM_pp", '_Measures'[Incident rate MoM pp]
	)
